chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Ḥumayd ibn Ziyād, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad al-Kindī, from more than one person, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: In how many garments is a woman shrouded? He said: “She is shrouded in five garments, one of them being the khimār.”

key_terms.الْخِمَارُ: a head-covering included among the woman's shrouding garments
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman, in the context of funerary rulings
key_terms.خَمْسَةِ أَثْوَابٍ: five garments used in the burial shroud

ai.seo_question: How many garments are used for the shrouding of a woman in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling for the kafan of a woman, specifying that she is shrouded in five garments. It further clarifies that one of these garments is the khimār, making the report relevant to funerary jurisprudence and rulings related to the preparation of the deceased.
